message.content: {"verdict":"FINDINGS","findings":[{"severity":"MINOR","description":"When `store.ready()` fails, the shared `Corestore` instance is removed from the `sharedStores` map but the underlying `Corestore` is not explicitly closed. While the instance becomes unreferenced and will eventually be garbage‑collected, it may leave open file descriptors until GC runs. A defensive improvement would be to `await store.close()` before deleting the map entry to avoid any temporary resource leakage."}]}
